N1.s: Tus %lld cutlings gratis ya están en uso. Continúa en Cutling, desbloquéalo y este quedará guardado.
N1.back: Your %lld cutlings free already are in use. Continue in Cutling, unlock-it and this-one will-remain saved.
N1.why: S3's 'ya están en uso' avoids choosing Spain's perfect or Mexico's preterite; 'Continúa en Cutling' echoes the system's continue button.

N3.why: Masculine participle agrees with cutling; 'te queda uno' is how a speaker says one is left, with no 'solo' to press, 29 characters.

N4.why: Reuses S5's 'Llevas X de Y' and S29's 'gratis', so 5 of 5 reads as full without a limit word; 30 characters at 5 of 5.

N5.why: S29's pair says the slots are full; 'guardarlo' points at the item they were just saving; exactly 40 characters at 5 of 5.

N6.why: S15's infinitive, as Spanish iOS labels its bar buttons; 11 characters, one over the 10 budget, because no shorter verb means unlock.
